newsitem.title: USA: MAXXAM to pull $200 mln shelf registration.
newsitem.headline: MAXXAM to pull $200 mln shelf registration.

text.p: MAXXAM Inc on Wednesday said it will withdraw its January 1996 shelf filing for $200 million in debt securities.
Capital requirements were instead met with an offering through its MAXXAM Group Holdings Inc unit last December, the company said.

At the same time, MAXXAM Group Holdings announced it has completed the exchange of its 12 percent Series B Senior Secured Notes due 2003 for the $130 million outstanding 12 percent Senior Secured Notes due 2003, which were sold in a 144A offering last December.
MAXXAM Group Inc engages in forest products operations through its subsidiaries. MAXXAM Inc operates primarily in the aluminum, forest products, and real estate industries.
